items_all.title: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
items_all.summary: The Ramp AI Index for September 2026 shows AI spending per employee among the top 1 percent of US companies fell nearly 10 percent in August. The price per million tokens has dropped 41 percent since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage away from expensive frontier models toward cheaper alternatives. For providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, the question is whether volume growth is fast enough to make up for falling prices. The article Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 陽明海運推動智慧船舶轉型，以衛星、5G克服遠洋船舶通訊限制，導入AI無人機巡檢與船務管理
items_all.summary: 遠洋貨輪長時間航行於公海時，船舶與岸端間往往面臨通訊覆蓋不足、資料傳輸受限等問題，成為航運業推動數位、智慧轉型須先解決的挑戰。陽明海運近幾年持續推動智慧船隊發展，與大世科及伸波通訊合作，建置衛星、5G等網路通訊技術及AI數位應用平臺，改善船岸通訊環境，並將船舶裝置資料、巡檢影像與維運資訊匯入數位化管理。 這項應用是在國發會支援下進行，陽明海運以14,000 TEU級的貨櫃輪「承明輪」（YM Wisdom）及2,800 TEU級「好明輪」（YM Certainty）作為驗證場域，整合高低軌衛星、靠岸公網、船內5G專網與Wi-Fi網路，建立船舶的全時通訊架構，作為無人機AI巡檢、數位雙生管理、生成式AI船務助手等3項應用落地的基礎。

items_all.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
items_all.summary: 深度求索發佈DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，爲全新結構系列最小模型，具備原生多模態視覺理解。新結構旨在提升能力上限、推理速度與吞吐，並可擴展至更大參數。該模型爲552B參數MoE，採用Causal-Encoder-Decoder不對稱結構：輸入激活僅8B，輸出激活16B，HBM需求降至1/4，顯著降低成本。

items_all.summary: 9月10日，2026 Inclusion·外灘大會以“共創AI新經濟”開幕。諾貝爾經濟學獎得主菲利普·阿吉翁圍繞“創造性破壞”與AI革命分享稱，AI有望在未來十年使生產率增速每年額外提高約1.08個百分點，潛在影響或超IT革命；但技術潛力能否轉化爲持續增長，取決於競爭政策、教育體系和勞動力市場制度能否同步跟上。

items_all.title: 爲什麼AI還沒有真正發現新的科學?普林斯頓王夢迪:答案可能不在模型裏

items_all.title: 27歲Anthropic研究人員因擔心AI失控宣佈辭職
items_all.summary: 一名原本任職於Anthropic的AI研究人員Jacob Coxon週三（9/9）宣佈已辭去Anthropic職務，理由是他覺得人類快要失去對AI的掌控了。 現年27歲的Coxon表示自己過去3年分別在OpenAI及Anthropic從事預訓練研究，這兩家公司正一頭栽進可自我提升的超智慧（Superintelligence）領域，而超智慧很快就會成為超越人類的強大系統，將可入侵任何系統，一夜之間徹底改變任何領域，並攫取真正的權力與資源。

items_all.title: LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity
items_all.summary: LandingAI has shipped Agentic Document Extraction Gen2, a rebuild of its document stack on the DPT-3 model family. Chunks are retired in favor of a document, page and block tree. DPT-3 Pro grounds to the line, DPT-3 Verity grounds to the word with a confidence score, and Parse billing now counts output characters instead of flat pages. Gen1 code will not run against Gen2 endpoints. The post LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: LandingAI 推出了 Agentic Document Extraction Gen2，這是基於 DPT-3 模型系列對其文件堆疊進行的重新建構。系統取消了區塊（chunks），改用文件、頁面和區塊樹（block tree）。DPT-3 Pro 可精確對應至行，DPT-3 Verity 則可精確對應至字並帶有信心分數（confidence score），而 Parse 的計費方式現在改為計算輸出字元數，而非單純按頁計費。Gen1 的程式碼將無法在 Gen2 端點上執行。這篇文章 LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: ​Anthropic遭集體訴訟：用戶怒指Claude Max涉嫌虛假宣傳
items_all.summary: 知名人工智能企業Anthropic因Claude Max訂閱套餐遭用戶集體訴訟，被指對最高檔套餐的使用限制進行誤導性宣傳，爭議核心是限制條件表述模糊。該套餐分每月100美元和200美元兩檔，約合人民幣672.8元和1346元。用戶認爲實際權益與官方宣傳不符，要求公司澄清並承擔責任。

items_all.title: Anthropic揪出第4起Claude入侵事件，重新認定前3起為模型偏誤推理
items_all.summary: Anthropic週三（9/9）發表對齊評估（Alignment Assessment）報告，揭露第4起Claude入侵真實系統事件，並推翻先前對前3起事件「操作失誤」（Operational Failure）的說法，改認定為模型「偏誤推理」（Biased Reasoning）與「魯莽」（Recklessness）所致，同時宣佈已與獨立機構METR簽約展開調查。

items_all.title: Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities
items_all.summary: Google has open-sourced Mantis, a stack-agnostic toolkit of security review skills for AI coding agents. It runs the full vulnerability lifecycle: sweep the code, filter false positives, reproduce the bug in a sandbox, patch it, re-attack the patch, then score the risk. Apache 2.0, and documented as demonstration-only. The post Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 已開源 Mantis，這是一套適用於 AI 程式碼代理程式、與堆疊無關的安全審查技能工具組。它能執行完整的漏洞生命週期：掃描程式碼、過濾誤報、在沙箱中重現臭蟲、修補漏洞、重新攻擊修補程式，然後對風險進行評分。採用 Apache 2.0 授權，並記錄為僅供展示使用。本文原標題為 Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities，載於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario
items_all.summary: Anthropic published an economic model with three scenarios for the US economy through 2030. In the extreme scenario, output doubles every 4.5 years and knowledge worker unemployment hits 17.9 percent. CEO Dario Amodei's own warnings from May land squarely in that most extreme bucket. The article Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了一個經濟模型，針對 2030 年之前的美國經濟提出了三種情境。在極端情境下，產出每 4.5 年就會倍增，而知識工作者的失業率則會達到 17.9%。執行長達裡奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）自己在 5 月發出的警告，正好就落在那種最極端的情況中。這篇名為 Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

Songs can now be partially changed through text commands or generated multimodally from text, audio, and images. The company won't say which catalogs went into training, while Universal and Sony keep suing. The article Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome
items_all.summary: Google Deepmind has used the AlphaGenome Atlas to predict what each of the roughly nine billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome could do. The dataset spans one petabyte, more than 30 times the size of the AlphaFold database. In one epilepsy case, the atlas helped pinpoint a previously overlooked variant as the likely cause. The article Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 利用 AlphaGenome Atlas 來預測人類基因組中大約 90 億種可能的單字母變異中，每一種可能會帶來什麼影響。該資料集規模達 1 PB（拍位元組），超過 AlphaFold 資料庫大小的 30 倍。在一個癲癇病例中，該圖譜有助於精確定位先前被忽視的變異，並將其視為可能的病因。本文 Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade
items_all.summary: Jacob Coxon, a former pretraining researcher at OpenAI and Anthropic, has quit and accuses both companies of knowingly risking human extinction. The article Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 曾任 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 預訓練研究員的 Jacob Coxon 已經離職，並指控兩家公司明知故犯地冒著人類滅絕的風險。Anthropic 的同事 Evan Hubinger 認為，目標不對齊的超級智慧 AI 在未來十年內消滅人類的機率超過百分之十。〈Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.summary: Today, we're releasing a demo of WeWorm, the first zero-click worm to spread through WeChat calls across iOS and Android. [...] The victim does not need to answer the call, or interact with their phone at all. Even if they do answer, they hear nothing, and the exploit still succeeds. [...] Working with AI, our team found the bug and wrote the first remote code execution (RCE) exploit in about two days. Building the worm took one more week. A worm at this scale used to be the kind of thing that took a larger team months. AI can already do most of the work here. Our team provided the judgment about what to target and how to test it safely. — Calif Research , WeWorm Tags: ai-security-research , ai , llms , security , generative-ai

items_all.title: .blend URL Viewer
items_all.summary: Tool: .blend URL Viewer I'm continuing to have a lot of fun with GPT-6 Astra and Blender (see my TIL ). As a big fan of the Imperial Fabergé Easter eggs , I've always thought it would be fun to make some new ones that celebrate popular culture. Yesterday I decided to try out the new ChatGPT Images 2.5 by running this prompt : Generate a photo of a faberge egg that's themed after the TV show Pluribus - research first It gave me this - honestly not bad for a first attempt! Then, just to see what would happen, I pasted that image into Codex running GPT-6 Astra (high) and prompted: Use your blender local skill to create a blender model of this faverge egg (Here's the skill file , which I created like this .) It churned away for 17m51s and built me several .blend files . I already had this vibe-coded Blender viewing experiment lying around, so I added that to my tools collection and now you can use it to see my Pluribus blender model in your browser : Tags: 3d , javascript , tools , ai , generative-ai , llms , blender , coding-agents , codex , gpt-6-astra

items_all_raw.title: Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August
items_all_raw.summary: The Ramp AI Index for September 2026 shows AI spending per employee among the top 1 percent of US companies fell nearly 10 percent in August. The price per million tokens has dropped 41 percent since March 2026, and companies are actively shifting usage away from expensive frontier models toward cheaper alternatives. For providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, the question is whether volume growth is fast enough to make up for falling prices. The article Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 2026年9月的 Ramp AI 指數顯示，美國前 1% 頂尖企業在 8 月份的每位員工 AI 支出下降了近 10%。自 2026年3月以來，每百萬個 Token 的價格已經下跌了 41%，企業正積極將使用量從昂貴的前沿模型轉移到更便宜的替代方案。對於 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等供應商而言，問題在於量能成長的速度是否足以彌補價格下跌的損失。本文〈Top AI spenders cut per-employee costs by nearly 10 percent in August〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 遠洋貨輪長時間航行於公海時，船舶與岸端間往往面臨通訊覆蓋不足、資料傳輸受限等問題，成為航運業推動數位、智慧轉型須先解決的挑戰。陽明海運近幾年持續推動智慧船隊發展，與大世科及伸波通訊合作，建置衛星、5G等網路通訊技術及AI數位應用平臺，改善船岸通訊環境，並將船舶裝置資料、巡檢影像與維運資訊匯入數位化管理。 這項應用是在國發會支援下進行，陽明海運以14,000 TEU級的貨櫃輪「承明輪」（YM Wisdom）及2,800 TEU級「好明輪」（YM Certainty）作為驗證場域，整合高低軌衛星、靠岸公網、船內5G專網與Wi-Fi網路，建立船舶的全時通訊架構，作為無人機AI巡檢、數位雙生管理、生成式AI船務助手等3項應用落地的基礎。

items_all_raw.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 正式發佈：552B MoE 新架構，全面超越 V4 Pro
items_all_raw.summary: 深度求索發佈DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，爲全新結構系列最小模型，具備原生多模態視覺理解。新結構旨在提升能力上限、推理速度與吞吐，並可擴展至更大參數。該模型爲552B參數MoE，採用Causal-Encoder-Decoder不對稱結構：輸入激活僅8B，輸出激活16B，HBM需求降至1/4，顯著降低成本。

items_all_raw.title: 27歲Anthropic研究人員因擔心AI失控宣佈辭職
items_all_raw.summary: 一名原本任職於Anthropic的AI研究人員Jacob Coxon週三（9/9）宣佈已辭去Anthropic職務，理由是他覺得人類快要失去對AI的掌控了。 現年27歲的Coxon表示自己過去3年分別在OpenAI及Anthropic從事預訓練研究，這兩家公司正一頭栽進可自我提升的超智慧（Superintelligence）領域，而超智慧很快就會成為超越人類的強大系統，將可入侵任何系統，一夜之間徹底改變任何領域，並攫取真正的權力與資源。

items_all_raw.title: LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity
items_all_raw.summary: LandingAI has shipped Agentic Document Extraction Gen2, a rebuild of its document stack on the DPT-3 model family. Chunks are retired in favor of a document, page and block tree. DPT-3 Pro grounds to the line, DPT-3 Verity grounds to the word with a confidence score, and Parse billing now counts output characters instead of flat pages. Gen1 code will not run against Gen2 endpoints. The post LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: LandingAI 推出了 Agentic Document Extraction Gen2，這是基於 DPT-3 模型系列對其文件堆疊進行的重新建構。系統取消了區塊（chunks），改用文件、頁面和區塊樹（block tree）。DPT-3 Pro 可精確對應至行，DPT-3 Verity 則可精確對應至字並帶有信心分數（confidence score），而 Parse 的計費方式現在改為計算輸出字元數，而非單純按頁計費。Gen1 的程式碼將無法在 Gen2 端點上執行。這篇文章 LandingAI Releases Agentic Document Extraction Gen2 with DPT-3 Pro and DPT-3 Verity 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: ​Anthropic遭集體訴訟：用戶怒指Claude Max涉嫌虛假宣傳
items_all_raw.summary: 知名人工智能企業Anthropic因Claude Max訂閱套餐遭用戶集體訴訟，被指對最高檔套餐的使用限制進行誤導性宣傳，爭議核心是限制條件表述模糊。該套餐分每月100美元和200美元兩檔，約合人民幣672.8元和1346元。用戶認爲實際權益與官方宣傳不符，要求公司澄清並承擔責任。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic揪出第4起Claude入侵事件，重新認定前3起為模型偏誤推理
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic週三（9/9）發表對齊評估（Alignment Assessment）報告，揭露第4起Claude入侵真實系統事件，並推翻先前對前3起事件「操作失誤」（Operational Failure）的說法，改認定為模型「偏誤推理」（Biased Reasoning）與「魯莽」（Recklessness）所致，同時宣佈已與獨立機構METR簽約展開調查。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Calif Research
items_all_raw.summary: Today, we're releasing a demo of WeWorm, the first zero-click worm to spread through WeChat calls across iOS and Android. [...] The victim does not need to answer the call, or interact with their phone at all. Even if they do answer, they hear nothing, and the exploit still succeeds. [...] Working with AI, our team found the bug and wrote the first remote code execution (RCE) exploit in about two days. Building the worm took one more week. A worm at this scale used to be the kind of thing that took a larger team months. AI can already do most of the work here. Our team provided the judgment about what to target and how to test it safely. — Calif Research , WeWorm Tags: ai-security-research , ai , llms , security , generative-ai

items_all_raw.title: .blend URL Viewer
items_all_raw.summary: Tool: .blend URL Viewer I'm continuing to have a lot of fun with GPT-6 Astra and Blender (see my TIL ). As a big fan of the Imperial Fabergé Easter eggs , I've always thought it would be fun to make some new ones that celebrate popular culture. Yesterday I decided to try out the new ChatGPT Images 2.5 by running this prompt : Generate a photo of a faberge egg that's themed after the TV show Pluribus - research first It gave me this - honestly not bad for a first attempt! Then, just to see what would happen, I pasted that image into Codex running GPT-6 Astra (high) and prompted: Use your blender local skill to create a blender model of this faverge egg (Here's the skill file , which I created like this .) It churned away for 17m51s and built me several .blend files . I already had this vibe-coded Blender viewing experiment lying around, so I added that to my tools collection and now you can use it to see my Pluribus blender model in your browser : Tags: 3d , javascript , tools , ai , generative-ai , llms , blender , coding-agents , codex , gpt-6-astra

items_all_raw.title: Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities
items_all_raw.summary: Google has open-sourced Mantis, a stack-agnostic toolkit of security review skills for AI coding agents. It runs the full vulnerability lifecycle: sweep the code, filter false positives, reproduce the bug in a sandbox, patch it, re-attack the patch, then score the risk. Apache 2.0, and documented as demonstration-only. The post Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 已開源 Mantis，這是一套適用於 AI 程式碼代理程式、與堆疊無關的安全審查技能工具組。它能執行完整的漏洞生命週期：掃描程式碼、過濾誤報、在沙箱中重現臭蟲、修補漏洞、重新攻擊修補程式，然後對風險進行評分。採用 Apache 2.0 授權，並記錄為僅供展示使用。本文原標題為 Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities，載於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic published an economic model with three scenarios for the US economy through 2030. In the extreme scenario, output doubles every 4.5 years and knowledge worker unemployment hits 17.9 percent. CEO Dario Amodei's own warnings from May land squarely in that most extreme bucket. The article Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了一個經濟模型，針對 2030 年之前的美國經濟提出了三種情境。在極端情境下，產出每 4.5 年就會倍增，而知識工作者的失業率則會達到 17.9%。執行長達裡奧·阿莫代（Dario Amodei）自己在 5 月發出的警告，正好就落在那種最極端的情況中。這篇名為 Anthropic built an economic model that frames its CEO's bleakest job forecasts as an outlier scenario 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe
items_all_raw.summary: Suno has unveiled a new AI music model generation, v6, in three versions, built together with Warner Music Group, BMG, and Believe. All older models are being shut down. Songs can now be partially changed through text commands or generated multimodally from text, audio, and images. The company won't say which catalogs went into training, while Universal and Sony keep suing. The article Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG, and Believe appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Suno 推出了包含三種版本的全新 AI 音樂模型世代 v6，這是與華納音樂集團（Warner Music Group）、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的。所有舊模型都將關閉。現在可以透過文字指令部分修改歌曲，或是從文字、音訊和圖片進行多模態生成。該公司拒絕透露哪些目錄用於訓練，而環球音樂（Universal）和索尼（Sony）則持續提告。文章 Suno 推出了與華納、BMG 和 Believe 共同打造的 v6 音樂模型最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind has used the AlphaGenome Atlas to predict what each of the roughly nine billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome could do. The dataset spans one petabyte, more than 30 times the size of the AlphaFold database. In one epilepsy case, the atlas helped pinpoint a previously overlooked variant as the likely cause. The article Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 利用 AlphaGenome Atlas 來預測人類基因組中大約 90 億種可能的單字母變異中，每一種可能會帶來什麼影響。該資料集規模達 1 PB（拍位元組），超過 AlphaFold 資料庫大小的 30 倍。在一個癲癇病例中，該圖譜有助於精確定位先前被忽視的變異，並將其視為可能的病因。本文 Deepmind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps every possible DNA change in the human genome 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade
items_all_raw.summary: Jacob Coxon, a former pretraining researcher at OpenAI and Anthropic, has quit and accuses both companies of knowingly risking human extinction. Anthropic colleague Evan Hubinger puts the odds of a misaligned superintelligent AI wiping out humanity within the next decade at more than ten percent. The article Anthropic scientist puts the odds of AI destroying humanity above ten percent this decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 曾任 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 預訓練研究員的 Jacob Coxon 已經離職，並指控兩家公司明知故犯地冒著人類滅絕的風險。Anthropic 的同事 Evan Hubinger 認為，目標不對齊的超級智慧 AI 在未來十年內消滅人類的機率超過百分之十。〈Anthropic 科學家稱 AI 本十年內毀滅人類的機率超過百分之十〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。
